# 7amdi

> Personal website of 7amdi, featuring recent Bluesky posts, top artists from Last.fm, and links to social profiles.

## About

This is 7amdi's personal site. It shows recent posts from Bluesky and top artists from Last.fm, with a short introduction and links to profiles and contact information.
